limits: Three samples per case; one GPU and model, 256-token capped answers.
Native token rates are engine timings, never stream chunk rates.
Append requests depend on preceding answers; actual request and output hashes match across all variants.
All shorter-prefix rewinds remain full reevaluation: 23252 evaluated tokens and74 cached tokens.
Fifth coverage-patch runs and final-stack qualification are pending; no new coverage gain is claimed.

baseline_byte_budget_pressure.interpretation: A larger baseline cache changes retention, not GPU token speed or code. 12288MiB is an isolated override, not an applied production setting.

limits: Selection uses receipt of router worker_queue timing event, not100ms state polling.
Follow-up starts at first busy heartbeat (~9.8s into baseline and~0.1s into candidate); compare completion-aligned intervals, not whole-arrival TTFT.
Inference service path after selection stays~167ms; measured gain removes stale-busy admission wait, not GPU decode work.
Physical measurement covers routed directSSE; buffered/tunnel timing belongs to separate controlled model-free fixtures.
Heartbeat phase controls the old delay; these runs do not establish a universal ten-second improvement.
